description: Implementation of the SiteForCookies class, managing site and scheme information for cookie handling, including methods for comparison, serialization, and origin/url conversions.

classes.name: SiteForCookies
classes.description: Represents a site for cookie operations, encapsulating site details, scheme considerations, and comparison logic.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SiteForCookies object for debugging.

methods.name: IsFirstParty
methods.description: Determines if a URL is considered first-party relative to this site.

methods.name: IsEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if another SiteForCookies object is equivalent to this one.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeSiteAndRevise
methods.description: Compares and potentially revises the site based on another SchemefulSite.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeOriginAndRevise
methods.description: Compares and potentially revises the site based on a URL origin.

methods.name: RepresentativeUrl
methods.description: Returns a representative URL for the site.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the site is null or opaque.

methods.name: IsSchemefullyFirstParty
methods.description: Checks if a URL is first-party considering schemeful mode.

methods.name: IsSchemelesslyFirstParty
methods.description: Checks if a URL is first-party ignoring scheme.

methods.name: MarkIfCrossScheme
methods.description: Marks the site as cross-scheme if applicable.
